own_site_check: theheightshandyman.com resolves and returns 200 (Vercel-hosted), but WebFetch of the live page confirms it is an UNRELATED homonymous business: The Heights Handyman serving South Euclid, University Heights, Cleveland Heights and Beachwood, OH (handyman and POS violation repair), not Tampa FL. Different service area, different state, no connection to the Google Maps listing at phone +1 813-480-1046. Ruled out, not used anywhere in this build. No other domain variant found. has_own_site stays false, as already confirmed by the Maps listing (no website field on the Google Business Profile).
email_note: No public email found after a reasonable search: WebFetch of facebook.com/TheHeightsHandyman returned only the Facebook login wall (no About/contact info accessible without authentication); WebSearch for "The Heights Handyman" Tampa FL Collin and for the phone number +1 813-480-1046 returned no matches tying an email to this specific business; WebSearch restricted to nextdoor.com, bbb.org and buzzfile.com returned no listing for this business under this name. Left null per no-invention rule; registered as pending_manual with phone and Facebook for manual DM/call outreach.
owner_note: Owner/operator referred to as both "Collin" and "Colin" across different Google reviews (Jessica Taylor and Esther Renteria use Collin; Matt Joy uses Colin). Used "Collin" on site copy as the more frequent spelling; not independently verified beyond the reviews themselves.
hours_note: Google Maps hours for Monday parsed as "9 AM to 5 AM", which is almost certainly a scraping/parsing artifact (every other weekday shows 9 AM to 5 PM). Not used on the site: the contact section uses a generic call-to-schedule message instead of a structured hours table, to avoid publishing an unverified/likely-wrong time range.
photos_curation_note: All 10 photos downloaded from the Google Business listing are real, first-party photos (no stock, no selfies). gmaps-2.jpg (shower tile with an "AFTER" text badge baked into the image) was the only one excluded from hero/gallery/about per the no-text-overlay gallery rule. Used: gmaps-10.jpg (fireplace mantle restoration, hero + logo/avatar placeholder + og:image), gmaps-5.jpg (porch railing and steps build, about + contact image), gmaps-6.jpg (patio wood ceiling, about), gmaps-3.jpg (kitchen backsplash/counters), gmaps-4.jpg (staircase renovation), gmaps-7.jpg (patio furniture before/after), gmaps-9.jpg (shower before/after), gmaps-1.jpg (finished porch exterior), gmaps-8.jpg (interior accent wall paint) across the gallery. No dedicated logo file exists for this business (no IG, no own site), so gmaps-10.jpg (the most polished, representative shot) is reused as the nav/footer avatar image in place of a logo, consistent with the adapted-variant rule for businesses with no branding assets.
build_note: Built from templates/light-v2/index.html via scripts/derive.py (content.json, no hand-written HTML). Palette auto-derived from the real photos by scripts/paleta_auto.py (hue 31, warm amber/wood tone, consistent with the kitchen/fireplace/wood-ceiling photography). Adapted variant: no booking platform, no public pricing, no public street address (contacto.mapa omitted in favor of a real work photo), CTA is tel: throughout. GATE OK: python3 scripts/gate.py the-heights-handyman-tampa --lang en --forbid "Lash Bloom,Yesi,West Palm,Cresthaven,519855,_lashbloom" (the literal substring "lash" was dropped from the forbid list after confirming its only matches were false positives in the English word "Backsplash", a real service term for this business, and the Spanish UI-sound word "flash" in the scroll-reveal hint copy inherited from the skeleton).
